notes.title: Announcement of Major Update: Sailing Together!
notes.content:
Hi, Captains

After several months of work, I'm thrilled to announce that the co-op mode is nearing completion. Around this fall, we'll be releasing Version 0.8! 

Alongside the  co-op mode, this update will introduce a new faction and new gameplay: Bounty Hunters, as well as new maps, missions, and extensive optimizations and improvements. 

Please stay tuned!

notes.title: Major Update 0.7 Patch has been released!
notes.content:
Dear Captains,
After months of hard work, Version 0.7 is finally here! A wealth of new content and features await your exploration.

Note: Old save files will no longer be compatible after this update. To continue playing the previous version, select Version 0.6896 from the version branches.

1. New Content

1.1 New Maps & Islands
    Desert of the Sun God: The largest map to date, divided into multiple zones with underground caves to explore.
    Stardust Ranch: A brand-new settlement and village.
    Other smaller islands.
1.2 New Gameplay: Town Defense Battles, Guard the town, or the villagers will be massacred by cannibals.
1.3 New Gameplay: All over the world, various treasure maps are scattered about. Become a treasure hunter and dig up the buried riches beneath the ground!
1.4 New Vehicle: Tricycle, A great helper for freight!
1.5 Custom Difficulty: Added customizable difficulty options to tailor your gameplay experience.
1.6 New Workbench: Can upgrade equipment to higher quality tiers.
1.7 New Gear & Weapons:Discover new weapons and equipment scattered across the world.
1.8 New Quests: Added major quests, side quests, and hidden quests.
1.9 New Enemies & Monsters: New foes with updated loot drops.
1.10 New Recipes: Dozens of new recipes for equipment, ship decor, and cooking.
1.11 New Items: Expanded salvage and excavation rewards with new items.
1.12 New Ship Area: Garage The lower deck now serves as a garage for storing multiple land vehicles.
1.13 Enhanced Loot Drops:Enemies now drop unique and varied loot.
1.14 New Ship Themes: Unlock fresh ship customization themes and paint jobs.
1.15 New Cabin Decor: Archaeology-themed cabin decorations added.
1.16 Ship Armor Upgrades: Scrap armor can now be upgraded.
1.17 Engine Affixes: Ship engines now feature more diverse affixes.
1.18 New NPCs: Meet new characters across the world.
1.19 New Collectible:  Ancient Saint Medallions

2. Features & Improvements

2.1 Revamped Sailing System: Ship draft depth and speed now depend on cargo weight. Plan component allocation carefully before departure.
2.2 Ship Damage Effects: Ships now show bullet holes after combat.
2.3 Camera Overhaul: Improved immersion and camera freedom.
2.4 Terrain Footsteps: Unique footstep sounds for different ground types.
2.5 Smoother Movement: Added jumping and refined character animations.
2.6 Performance Optimizations: Framerate improvements across the board.
2.7 Volume Settings: Added audio volume controls.
2.8 Crosshair Customization: Adjustable crosshair size and spread for firearms.
2.9 Enhanced Desert Textures: Improved material quality in desert zones.
2.10 Smarter AI: Ranged NPCs now maintain distance, reload ammunition, and act more intelligently.
2.11 Improved Tutorials: Interactive ship components now display helpful tooltips.
2.12 Collision Fixes: Reduced clipping during swimming.
2.13 Non-Perishable Items: Cooling Wine and Medicinal Soup no longer spoil.
2.14 Sound Effect Tweaks: Enhanced in-game audio.
2.15 Task Board Lighting: Added torch lighting to quest boards.
2.16 Stardust Bay Ambiance: Environment-friendly torch lighting added.
2.17 Steering action: Now the character will correctly grip the ship's rudder when steering the ship.
2.18 Ship lighting: Added lights to the rear deck.

3. Bug Fixes

3.1 Monsters now respond correctly to sound and scent. Using loud weapons and carrying body odor will be more dangerous
3.2 Fixed muzzle deviation issues during pistol firing
3.3 Fixed an issue where the right hand would detach from the model when holding firearms
3.4 Fixed camera clipping into monster models
3.5 Fixed getting stuck when attacked while climbing ladders
3.6 Fixed collision with seagulls when sailing at excessive speed
3.7 Fixed garbled text in Japanese NPC dialogues
3.8 Fixed price list display issues in Russian language
3.9 Fixed multiple audio errors
3.10 Fixed text corruption when switching certain languages in-game
3.11 Fixed missing mission markers beyond map boundaries
3.12 Fixed occasional incorrect character spawn positions upon game entry
3.13 Fixed multiple translation errors
3.14 Fixed Kongzhu (Spider Fear) getting stuck when attacked
3.15 Fixed incorrect arrow attachment points on multiple monsters
3.16 Fixed cannon turrets causing self-damage
3.17 Fixed incorrect sound effect range for Desert Reaper
3.18 Fixed missing footstep sounds when sprinting with firearms

Set sail and explore the uncharted! 🌊⚓

notes.title: Announcement of Major Update
notes.content:
Hi, Captains

We are deeply grateful for the feedback from players since the game's release. 

After several minor updates, the current version has basically stabilized, and we will now fully devote ourselves to the development of the next major update, which is scheduled for approximately April. This update will include multiple new islands such as the Stardust Ranch, one new vehicle, new hidden quests, new reputation quests, new shipboard equipment, new recipes, new gear, and new gameplay features.

Please stay tuned!

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
1，Now, priests will sell holy water that can cleanse the sins you have committed, but you must stay away from the crime scene.
2，Aged alcohols can now be stacked.
3，Reduced the penalty of water consumption when overheated.
4，Reduced the wave intensity near certain small islands.
5，Workers and porters in Stardust Bay now belong to the jurisdiction of Stardust Bay. Please do not harm them easily.
6，Fixed the bug where items carried by workers would float after their death.
7，Fixed the issue where certain NPCs had incorrect attack animations.
8，Fixed the problem where character UI display was incomplete under certain fonts.
9，Now, when a vehicle is damaged, the driver will suffer attack damage.

notes.title: The demo's version number has been updated to the official version!
notes.content:
The EA is coming. To better acquaint everyone with the game, we have upgraded the demo's core to the official version and added support for Russian.
The detailed update contents of the demo include:
1. Added Russian language support.
2. Comprehensive UI upgrade.
3. Introduced thunderstorm weather, requiring caution against lightning during navigation.
4. Introduced wind system, necessitating attention to wind conditions during navigation.
5. Brand-new difficulty system: Survival is easier on lower difficulties, resource acquisition is simpler, and sailing speed and character running speed are faster.
6. Added anchors to ships.
7. Added telephones to ships, enabling communication with other ships using horns.
8. Implemented a harbor docking mechanism; docking in harbors will fully stabilize ships.
9. Introduced a weight system, with three weight options now available.
10.Added an engine upgrade module for the mechanic-merchant in Canopy Village.
11. The game can now be paused and settings changed through the settings interface within the game.
Updated some models.
12. Fixed numerous bugs.
13. Optimized resource consumption in the startup interface.
